newsitem.title: GERMANY: German handling firm extends Spanish operations.
newsitem.headline: German handling firm extends Spanish operations.

text.p: Ineuropa Handling, a subsidiary of Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG), will start handling operations at four Spanish airports in competition to Iberia from November 4, an FAG statement said.
Ineuropa Handling has already acquired ten airlines as clients for the airports of Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza and Alicante, the FAG statement added.
The company is a passenger, cargo and aircraft handling venture between FAG, two Spanish building companies and their joint subsidiary Ineuropa S.A.
Ineuropa Handling now has 40 airline clients at Teneriffe South airport where it started operations in November 1994, the statement said.
It will shortly take over handling at Teneriffe for German holiday airline Condor, the statement added.

The company, will use its experience of handling at Teneriffe to offer clients a standard handling service at all stations, the statement said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
